evaluation.caveat: Measured on a synthetic world our own generator wrote (seed-campaign: the seed-42 demo world plus three injected call-centre campaigns); the campaigns show the machinery works, not that it works on a real wallet's traffic, and no real baseline exists: four weeks of synthetic history, week 0 backfilled from later weeks. The ten-sender floor was set knowing the largest benign cell is seven, so the benign result is partly by construction. The paydays carry no person-to-person surge in this world, so the payday rows check the cell design on ordinary payday traffic, and the wedding is three cash-outs that no payment stream holds. Amount links are off. Retained money counts only funds credited by the flag; money saved is not claimed. The nominal false-incident figure is a p-branch union bound; the measured counts per route come from this world and its campaign-free replay. No threshold sweep, blind seeds or live audit in this run.
